scientific_question: At the same twelve fitted parameters and 13A+1A-transpose non-anchor budget as v167, can a boundary-tapered divergence-free local vortex flow repair both late five-camera gradient tails?
role: result-blind controlled virtual-BOST mechanism diagnostic; no v168 scientific array may be read before this contract and both implementations are committed
physical_hypothesis: v167 mixed local transport with compression. Curl-generated local velocity removes compression exactly while retaining rotation and shear, testing whether the missing sparse-view correction is solenoidal.

mechanism_boundary.distinct_from_v167: v167 used four soft-partition local translations with a non-unit continuity density factor; v168 uses four tapered vector potentials whose twelve curls are analytically divergence-free and whose density factor is one
mechanism_boundary.equal_parameter_budget: four fixed scalar envelopes times three vector-potential axes equals twelve fitted coefficients
mechanism_boundary.equal_exact_call_budget: twelve tangent forwards plus one final forward and one current adjoint
mechanism_boundary.not_parameter_search: centres, Gaussian width, taper, SVD cutoff, cap, RK4 steps, interpolation, H1 multiplier, data, controls, metrics, and thresholds are frozen

new_data_boundary.senior_instruction: generate two-component 2D displacement fields from the executable 3D density field and camera positions
new_data_boundary.historical_pairing_status: the old real 2D-to-3D correspondence is unavailable and is not inferred
new_data_boundary.claim_boundary: all observations use the frozen straight-ray virtual proxy; real_bost remains false

frozen_predecessor.closed_family: fixed four-region stationary local continuity flow

source_semantics.density_output: first TorchScript output is density; require finite values only and apply no clipping or offset
source_semantics.synthetic_pairing: camera-field pairing and observations are generated by code; no true experimental pairing is inferred
source_semantics.source: direct clarification from the supervising senior, inherited from v167

inputs.models: same nine CPU TorchScript models sealed by v157-v167
inputs.calibrations: same thirteen nine-camera JSON files sealed by v157-v167
inputs.calibration_root_contract: corrected package_v2 root bound by v167

representation.field_subspace: zero-mean orthonormal DCT 16x8x8 excluding the constant coefficient
representation.initial_anchor: t=0 uses frozen isotropic H1 fixed-0.03
representation.gaussian_width_derivation: half the tetrahedral centre separation, sigma=sqrt(2/3)
representation.boundary_taper: B(s)=product_j(1-s_j^2)^2 inside the cube and zero outside; B and grad B vanish on every face
representation.continuity_tangents: -u_rj dot grad(rho_previous), using the centered zero-extension derivative
representation.observation_fit: column-normalized minimum-norm SVD of twelve projected tangents against current observation innovation
representation.speed_cap: analytic envelope-gradient bound scales all parameters once so speed is at most h_min*time_delta/0.25
representation.flow_integration: fixed 16-step RK4 inverse characteristics; density factor exactly one
representation.flow_roundtrip_audit: fixed forward/backward RK4 on the Cartesian 3x3x3 boundary-midpoint lattice
representation.exact_density_action: tensor-product Catmull-Rom sampling with explicit zero extension and no Jacobian multiplier
representation.zero_mean_projection: remove transported-field mean because the DCT subspace excludes the constant
representation.current_solve: (G+alpha H)c=q+alpha H c_transport with isotropic H1 and alpha=0.03 times the frozen geometry scale
representation.no_transport_control: same causal centered-H1 recurrence without fitted flow
representation.previous_state: immediately previous reconstruction of the same arm/model/calibration/camera set
representation.permutation_contract: camera-row reordering leaves fit, prior, and reconstruction invariant
representation.variable_cardinality: same mechanism rebuilt for 5, 7, and 9 cameras
representation.forbidden_variants: no centre/width/taper search, affine or translation term, compressible density factor, truth state, reset, alternate cap/SVD/interpolation/anchor/RK method, learned transition, selector, or post-result multiplier

arms.same_cost_local_continuity_control: frozen v167 four-region local continuity flow

metrics: p50/p90-higher/worst by time, arm, and camera count
rank, condition, fit residual, cap, displacement, unit density factor, boundary values, divergence, roundtrip, stationarity, and permutation audit

cost_accounting.primary_online_after_geometry_cache: 12 tangent A plus final A plus current A-transpose
cost_accounting.resource_claim: forbidden until a later fresh-process wall and RSS gate

independent_recomputation.physics: independent camera rays and sparse operators
independent_recomputation.local_flow: independently rebuild envelopes, curls, tangents, SVD fit, cap, RK4 flow, unit density factor, and sampler without formal helpers
independent_recomputation.solver: independent generalized eigendecomposition and centered-H1 solve

decision_order: Any validity or independent-recomputation failure makes v168 inconclusive.
Only the frozen four-envelope divergence-free vortex primary may be judged.
Pass requires all 12 strata, nine-camera parent no-harm, and strict t=0.75 five-camera improvement versus frozen H1.
If no-transport also passes, vortex transport receives no credit.
A valid failure closes only this exact local divergence-free vortex family and does not authorize tuning, a larger model, or GPU rescue.
A valid pass establishes only controlled virtual-proxy headroom and authorizes a separately frozen minimal CPU predictor diagnostic.
